value: Usable via transformers (v4.53.0+) with AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer and chat template; also vLLM and SGLang for OpenAI-compatible API serving; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch. Chat format supports /think and /no_think system prompt flags or enable_thinking kwarg; tool calling via xml_tools or python_tools.
quote: The modeling code for SmolLM3 is available in transformers `v4.53.0`, so make sure to upgrade your transformers version.
